companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Join the team building the robots that run Australia's warehouses.

Hello, g'day, kia ora! Thanks for stopping by. This fictional posting is test data for LVLme.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Running the rollout of new robot fleets at customer sites, from survey to handover.
  • Keeping engineering, field and customer teams on one deployment plan.
  • Reporting progress and risks to the operations leadership every week.

You're probably a match if

  • You have 6+ years of program or operations management in logistics or industrial settings.
  • You have led cross-functional teams through complex hardware deployments.

What you'll learn and how you'll develop at Initech Robotics

  • You'll learn how autonomous fleets are commissioned at scale.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Experience with safety management systems in a regulated industry.

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying autonomous mobile robots.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text: Our campus is in Melbourne, and you choose the balance of office and home that works for your team.
